dialog-body: Only this date changes. Answers stay as they are. Times are in {{tz}}.
error-bad-end: The end has to be after the start.
error-collides: That time is on or past another date of this event.
error-forbidden: Only the host or a co-host can change dates.
error-incomplete: Choose a date and a start time.
error-move-past: Pick a time in the future.
error-too-many: An event can have at most 52 changed dates.
saved: Date changed. Everyone who answered was told.
skipped-toast: Date skipped. Everyone who answered was told.
